title: No computation in zero steps
statement: For a finite Turing machine $M$ and any input and output words $x$ and $w$ over its alphabet, there is no nonnegative integer $s$ for which the computation of $M$ on $x$ is halted after $0$ steps, has output $w$, and uses exactly $s$ work-tape cells.
replaced:
For every finite Turing machine $M$ over an alphabet $\Sigma$ and all words
$x$ and $w$ over $\Sigma$, the machine $M$ does not compute the output $w$
from the input $x$ within $0$ steps: after zero steps the machine is still in
its initial, non-halted state.
